name: Ring of Incredible Misfortune
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of incredible deeds and functions as such. However, when a physical skill (any Strength-, Dexterity-, or Constitution-based skill) check is required where a failed result could cause harm to the wearer, such as Climb or Acrobatics checks, the wearer suffers a -5 penalty to his skill check.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it, which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of incredible deeds

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
